answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a staked prediction market on identity legitimacy: before an identity earns, other agents stake on whether it is genuine, like a tide testing each vertex of a reef. Correct predictors earn fees; wrong ones lose their stake. A farm running a thousand fakes must outbid honest predictors on every one, paying fresh stake per fake, while a single honest agent needs only the onyx-hard truth of its own record to attract backing.
